The '''Imperial Archives''' was a archival [[Museum/Legends|museum]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It held a small [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] vault with a [[Carbonite Sith Army holocron|mysterious]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] inside.<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

The vault was perhaps the most heavily guarded room in the museum. Imperial [[Force Adept]]s as well as [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]] and elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] squads all guarded the room.<ref name="FoC" />

Other rooms in the museum held scale models of different planets, like [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. There was a room filled with scale models of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|armed forces]], like [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]], [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], and even a model of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. Many of these models could, when faced with threat, activate and fire at enemies. This happened to Silri when all three phases of Dark Troopers activated as she came near.<ref name="FoC" />

==History==
[[File:ZannHolocron.jpg|thumb|left|75px|The [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] on the altar.]]

[[Tyber Zann]] and his forces [[Raid on the Imperial Archive|attacked]] from three different directions to attempt to steal the emperor's passkey: Zann started just outside the Cantina, [[Urai Fen]] started in the Museum ducts, and [[Silri]] started at the center of the museum. Zann and his forces were able to fight through the different defenses in the museum, including the dark trooper models. Although skilled, the Force Adepts were also bested by Zann's forces, and he stole the artifact.<ref name="FoC" />

The archives were tended to by librarians which helped categorize materials. One of the librarians that worked in the archives after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] that went by the codename, "[[Tigress]]." She was eventually found out, [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] and then executed by the Empire.<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Archives were briefly mentioned in the role-playing scenario, ''[[Death-Hunter]]''. This same term was used to describe the museum encountered in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''. It is possible that this museum is one and the same with the [[Galactic Museum/Legends|Galactic Museum]]. Other sources suggest that Palpatine's private collections were housed in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] in [[Imperial Palace Vaults|Palpatine's Vaults]]. Since this museum does not seem to be a part of the Palace, it may be a different location, though it is difficult to understand why the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] would have housed his Holocron outside the Palace.
